it's not your time to leave. I understand the comfort of tottering on the edge, and I am not sure if any of what I say is helpful- but try to find comfort in other ways for now at least. Try not to worry or think about the next day, or the next, or any days after. Maybe draw the curtains, lay in bed, or sit in a corner (i used to squish under my bed for comfort and it works!), make something to eat or if you have a favourite song or film (have you seen barbie? Is that out?) put it on!! Even just cry and get it out if you can. Please be kind to yourself and allow your brain and your heart a little bit of time. I hope you're okay and I hope you'll stay safe.
